title: textrar 0.9.0
text: Fixed .Rbuildignore tools/ directory longer shipped source package. Enabled TLS certificate verification: get_token() post_request() longer set ssl_verifypeer = FALSE. responses now parsed plain $ extraction instead `$`(_, "x") pipe placeholder. behavior unchanged, package longer needs R 4.2: DESCRIPTION declares R >= 3.6, ‘httr’ asks . unused LazyData field removed. gen_params() get_token() now read credentials environment variables TEXTRA_API_KEY, TEXTRA_API_SECRET TEXTRA_NAME default, keys need written scripts. Passing explicitly still works. unset variable now raises informative error instead sending empty credential. Breaking: failures now raise error instead returning NULL. get_token() stops ‘TexTra’ rejects credentials, extract_result() stops API reports failure. API answers HTTP 200 even fails reports failure resultset$code, status code alone never enough detect . Code tested result .null() needs use tryCatch(). post_request(), extract_result() base_url() deprecated. low level building blocks never meant part public interface. still work, warn, removed future release. Use textra() instead; rely reach endpoint textra() cover, please open issue https://github.com/matutosi/textrar/issues. Added testthat (edition 3) suite. tests run without touching network; ones call API skipped unless TEXTRA_TEST_LIVE set, consume API quota every check. Documentation fixes: textra() translation model, transliteration one; name gen_params() login ID; broken examples post_request() extract_result() corrected.
